Population increased in Nottinghamshire

The estimated population of Nottinghamshire in 2024 was 857,013 usual residents, a rise of 1.2% since 2023.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Nottinghamshire increased by 3.7%.

Age profile of Nottinghamshire

The average (median) age fell to 43.4 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Nottinghamshire has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.source: Office for National Statistics – Mid-year population estimates

sections.content:
By age category, Nottinghamshire's population of 857,013 usual residents was made up of:

  • 152,077 people aged 0 to 15 years, (17.7%)
  • 520,294 people aged 16 to 64 years, (60.7%)
  • 184,642 people aged 65 years and over, (21.5%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Nottinghamshire has a slightly higher proportion of people aged 65 years and over (21.5% compared with 18.9% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Nottinghamshire, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net internal migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Nottinghamshire
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Nottinghamshire, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More deaths than births led to a fall in the population of 1,514 people (-0.2%). In total, there were 7,500 births and 9,014 deaths in Nottinghamshire.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) increased the population by 7,698 (0.9%). There were 44,111 people entering the area and 36,413 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Nottinghamshire's population of 4,043 (0.5%) as a result of 6,680 people entering the area and 2,637 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Nottinghamshire was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Nottinghamshire in mid-2023 is 846,728.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 2,092 people and internal migration estimates were revised upwards by 142 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 2,234 people.
